items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: I think Russell, this Louis Russell, I think, then took the band over or something.

ctx.x: Joe was having a hard time then, huh?

Well, those New York musicians, they was against those Western boys coming in there. That's the guys coming from Chicago, you know? It seemed to give them a hard way to go, you know? And I think that's where his band broke up from him there, you know? I think Russell, this Louis Russell, I think, then took the band over or something. The piano player. Hmm? But then I went, I went, then he started, he was getting jobs like in Atlantic City, you know? I went with him twice to Atlantic City. He's in Ryan. On, yeah,…
Did he have any other New Orleans musicians with him? Anybody else remember being outstanding?
